vibe_rationale: Billed as the longest-running vintage longboard contest, with deep log culture and strict old-board rules; authentic, but a single-scene contest rather than a festival.
fit_notes: Small, authentic surf crowd with an active lifestyle and a post-surf recovery angle; competitors range from age 7 to 70-plus. Twenty-eight listed sponsors with a partnership page and contact email, including health-adjacent partners such as EyeQ Optometry and SurfAid. The 100 figure is competitors only, so spectator reach is unknown.
